title: Golden Hour by the Tide
story: The evening we forgot what time it was because the waves kept erasing our footprints and you laughed every time the cold water caught your dress.
secretNote: I knew right there on the wet sand that I wanted a thousand more summers beside you.

title: Two Coffees & The Rainy Window
story: That Saturday storm trapped us at the corner booth for four hours. We drew constellations on napkins and ranked every terrible rom-com we ever watched.
secretNote: I kept the napkin with your handwriting in the back of my wallet until it tore at the folds.

title: The First Wax-Sealed Letter
story: Written by candlelight before we even exchanged gifts. Folded in heavy cream stationery, sealed in deep burgundy wax, and kept under lock until midnight.
secretNote: Read paragraph three whenever you miss me—every word still holds true.

title: Midnight Kitchen Slow Dance
story: No fancy reservation, just one warm lamp over the stove, pasta simmering, and our favorite vinyl spinning softly while we danced in socks on the kitchen tile.
secretNote: The kitchen floor is still my favorite ballroom on earth.

title: Pressed Crimson Rose No. 1
story: The first flower you tucked inside my hardcover book so it wouldn't wilt on the train home. Months later, its petals still hold the exact shade of your lipstick.
secretNote: Open page 114 whenever you want to find its twin petal.

title: Rooftop Starlight & Polaroids
story: Wrapped in one oversized cream blanket on the roof, counting satellites until 2 AM and taking blurry flash selfies we refused to delete.
secretNote: This is the night we promised to build our own little museum someday—and here it is.
